title: 第23章 吞天蟒之威第24章 神魂剑阵
content_zh:
“什么？他依靠实力破掉了王师兄的光影剑法？！”
李山等人都爆发出一阵惊呼。
本以为林炎只是仗着毒道之力，没曾想真实战力也这般恐怖，竟然不弱王长东。
“好强大的战斗意识！怪不得能在天才修炼塔上将我挤下来！”
王长东都脸色大变，同为天才他一眼就看出林炎的意识强大到了绝巅，竟能从纷纷扰扰中找到真正的破绽。
哪怕是气海八重，也都很难有这样的眼界啊！
不过他毕竟也是优秀弟子之中的佼佼者，手段也不会就这么点。
“金蛇剑法！”
只见王长东手中的光剑一抖，剑势陡变，原本凶悍的剑招一下子变得犀利、毒辣了起来。
这也是一门玄阶高级剑法！
锵锵锵！
剑势如蛇，刁钻凶悍，专门攻击林炎身体的薄弱之地。
“你有金蛇，我有吞天蟒！”
林炎手掌一拍，一道五彩斑斓的拳印打出，蕴含着五彩吞天蟒的血脉之力，原本刁钻的金蛇好似被克制了一般，在五彩吞天蟒的力道之下节节败退。
连带着王长东也被逼的不断后退。
“怎么会这样？”
王长东几乎要抓狂了，本以为自己凭借境界优势，再加上剑法繁多能够压制林炎，毕竟林炎不管多妖孽，也始终只是一个新人。
可谁曾想，自己的招数在林炎面前被克制的死死的。
仿佛不管自己有任何手段，林炎都能破之。
他从未遇到过这样棘手的对手，而且更让王长东不安的是，林炎自始至终都无比的从容，闲庭信步，好似根本没动用全力。

他无法理解，为何一个气海一重会有如此逆天的实力。
“王长东，如果你只有这点手段的话，就给我败吧。”
林炎有些失望。
他之所以没动用毒道之力对付王长东，纯粹是想看看外山优秀弟子佼佼者的水平，现在看来却让他大失所望。
“林炎，你别嚣张，我还有一道底牌，绝对可以镇压你！”
王长东猛地大吼一声，而后将全身真气都灌注至兵器之中，原本银色的剑体竟然发出璀璨金光，一阵神秘的气息笼罩了天地间。
“这是剑意！王长东居然领悟了剑意！”
附近一些观战的优秀弟子脸色一变。
“什么？居然是剑意！不是说外山优秀弟子之中无人领悟剑意吗？”
其他弟子一听都哗然，所谓剑意，是将一门剑术修炼到登峰造极，才能诞生的力量，蕴含了剑的意志，神挡杀神佛挡杀佛，超越普通杀招。
只是剑意难领悟，目前外山只有那些精英弟子才领悟了剑意，不曾想王长东居然也领悟了剑意。
“这剑意貌似不是金蛇剑法和光影剑法的剑意，这股剑意有点像是玄阶中级剑法，炽火剑法。”
有一位资深优秀弟子皱着眉。
“怪不得，原来王长东领悟的是玄阶中级剑法的剑意，我说他怎么这么妖孽，居然能领悟玄阶高级剑意。”
“哪怕只是玄阶中级剑法的剑意，也始终是剑意啊，比普通玄阶高级剑法都更强一筹，恐怕唯有玄阶大圆满的战法才能在威力上相提并论了。”
“……”
“这就是你的终极底牌吗？如果是玄阶高级剑法的剑意，或许还真可能对我构成几分威胁，可区区玄阶中级剑法剑意，也敢放肆？”
林炎摇头，很是失望。
他一直都没动用全力，为的就是给王长东施展拳脚的机会，想要看看王长东是否有资格与他全力一战。
content_en:
"What? He relied on his strength to defeat Senior Brother Wang's light and shadow swordsmanship?!"
Li Shan and others burst into exclamations.
I thought that Lin Yan was just relying on the power of poison, but he never thought that his real combat power was so terrifying, and he was not weaker than Wang Changdong.
"What a strong sense of fighting! No wonder he squeezed me down from the genius training tower!"
Wang Changdong's expression changed greatly. As a genius, he could tell at a glance that Lin Yan's consciousness was extremely powerful and he could actually find the real flaw in the chaos.
Even if you are at the eighth level of Qi Sea, it is difficult for you to have such a vision!
But after all, he is also the best among outstanding disciples, and his methods are not limited to this.
"Golden Snake Sword Technique!"
I saw the lightsaber in Wang Changdong's hand trembling, and the sword's power suddenly changed. The originally fierce sword moves suddenly became sharp and vicious.
This is also an advanced Xuan-level swordsmanship!
Clang, clang, clang!
The sword was as powerful as a snake, cunning and fierce, specifically attacking the weak points of Lin Yan's body.
"You have the golden snake, and I have the sky-swallowing python!"
Lin Yan claps his palm, and a colorful fist seal is shot out, which contains the power of the blood of the five-color sky-swallowing python. The originally cunning golden snake seems to be restrained, and is retreating steadily under the power of the five-color sky-swallowing python.
Even Wang Changdong was forced to retreat continuously.
"How could this happen?"
Wang Changdong was almost going crazy. He thought that he could suppress Lin Yan with his realm advantage and various sword skills. After all, no matter how evil Lin Yan was, he was still just a newcomer.
But who would have thought that his moves would be completely restrained in front of Lin Yan.
It seemed that no matter what method he had, Lin Yan could defeat it.
He has never encountered such a difficult opponent, and what makes Wang Changdong even more uneasy is that Lin Yan was extremely calm from beginning to end, strolling around, as if he didn't use all his strength at all.
He couldn't understand why a person with the first level of Qihai had such heaven-defying strength.
"Wang Changdong, if you only have this means, just defeat me."
Lin Yan was a little disappointed.
The reason why he did not use the power of the poisonous path to deal with Wang Changdong was purely because he wanted to see the level of the outstanding disciples from outside the mountain, but now it seemed that he was greatly disappointed.
"Lin Yan, don't be arrogant, I still have a trump card that can definitely suppress you!"
Wang Changdong roared loudly, and then poured all his energy into the weapon. The originally silver sword body emitted a bright golden light, and a mysterious aura enveloped the world.
"This is the sword's intention! Wang Changdong actually understood the sword's intention!"
The expressions of some of the outstanding disciples watching the battle nearby changed.
"What? It's actually the sword's intention! Didn't it mean that none of the outstanding disciples in Waishan understood the sword's intention?"
The other disciples were in an uproar when they heard it. The so-called sword intention is the power that can only be born after practicing a sword skill to its peak. It contains the will of the sword. Gods can kill gods and Buddhas, and they can surpass ordinary killing moves.
It's just that the sword's intention is difficult to comprehend. Currently, only the elite disciples in Waishan have comprehended the sword's intention. Unexpectedly, Wang Changdong also comprehended the sword's intention.
"This sword intention does not seem to be the sword intention of the Golden Snake Sword Technique and the Light and Shadow Sword Technique. This sword intention is a bit like the Xuan Level Intermediate Sword Technique and the Blazing Fire Sword Technique."
A senior and outstanding disciple frowned.
"No wonder, it turns out that Wang Changdong understood the sword intention of the Xuan-level intermediate swordsmanship. I asked him how could he be such a monster, and he could actually understand the Xuan-level advanced sword intention."
"Even if it is just the sword intention of the Xuan-level intermediate swordsmanship, it is still the sword's intention. It is stronger than the ordinary Xuan-level advanced swordsmanship. I am afraid that only the Xuan-level Dzogchen swordsmanship can be compared in terms of power."
"..."
"Is this your ultimate trump card? If it is the sword intention of the Xuan-level advanced swordsmanship, it may really pose some threat to me, but the sword intention of the intermediate Xuan-level swordsmanship dares to be so unbridled?"
Lin Yan shook his head, very disappointed.
He never used all his strength just to give Wang Changdong a chance to show off his skills and to see if Wang Changdong was qualified to compete with him.Fight with all your strength.
